The shares were sold pursuant to Automatic Sale Instructions adopted by the reporting person on March 17, 2023, which are intended to satisfy the affirmative defense conditions of Rule 10b5-1(c). The instructions require the sale of shares sufficient to satisfy tax withholding obligations upon vesting of restricted stock units granted on February 17, 2023. The sale was made solely to satisfy tax withholding obligations from the vesting of those restricted stock units on October 1, 2026, and was not a discretionary trade by the reporting person.
